newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends at 1.0394 per dlr in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends at 1.0394 per dlr in thin trade.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.08 percent to close at 1.0394 per dollar in sluggish trading in the commercial foreign exchange market before the Christmas break, dealers said.
Trading occurred only during the morning and was restricted to banks squaring off positions for the end of the year, they said.
In the floating-rate foreign exchange market, the real rose 0.01 percent to close at 1.0443 per dollar. There was no trading in the parallel market, they said.
